title: kids_rules
description: Rule object of the kids mode, the same on the levels profile, area and entity. A missing field is inherited from the more general level (entity -> area -> profile); null for rate_limit/volume_max switches the rule off on that level. Access: entity blocked, else area blocked, else effective blocked_types (area, else profile), else profile blocked. An entity placed in several visible areas is checked per area; any block wins. blocked_types is not allowed on the entity level (422 rules.blocked_types). Invalid objects: 422 with detail rules.<field>.

blocked.description: true = everything in this scope blocked; false = explicitly allowed (overrides blocked_types and blocked of the more general levels).

blocked_types.description: Profile and area only; on the area level it replaces the profile's list.

quiet_hours.description: Bedtime windows; [] = no bedtime on this level (exception, e.g. a night light).

color_lock.description: Lights: no rgb/rgbw/rgbww/hs/xy color, color_name, effect, flash. On/off, brightness and color_temp_kelvin stay allowed.

volume_max.description: Volume cap in percent for media_player: volume_set above it is set to the cap (answer adjusted), volume_up at the cap is rejected (volume_limit), just below it becomes volume_set(cap); unknown volume rejects volume_up.
